name: Ages of Conflict: World War Simulator (itch.io)
description: This benchmark assesses grand-strategy simulation by spawning and observing AI nations in procedurally generated worlds. It tests map-based conquest mechanics, diplomatic relations, economic modeling, and long-term military campaign management.
general_score_metric: world conquest or simulation stability metrics
reputation: Popular indie browser-based war simulator on itch.io praised for depth and replayability
notes: Procedural single-player map simulation; strong for evaluating emergent strategy and multi-faction interaction modeling
